== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Wraith]] Horn is a wide-mouthed trumpet crafted from the [[binding]] of [[Subject One]]. Its exterior features intricate carvings that give it a natural, seashell-like appearance. Though it resembles a bone drinking horn and possesses an [[aura]] of immense strength and a metallic scent, the object is actually a powerful [[construct]]. Its presence is so potent that it distorts the surrounding atmosphere and can transform common animals into minor [[dreadbeasts]]. [[Reigan Shen]] utilizes the Horn as a vital lifeline and a tool for communication and control. By sounding a call through the instrument, he can contact [[Dreadgods]], such as the [[Bleeding Phoenix]], making the summons appear to originate from the [[Slumbering Wraith]] itself. Extensive research and specialized [[inheritance]] suggest that the Horn has the theoretical capacity to command the [[Dreadgods]], preventing them from defying its user for a period of time.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Wraith]] Horn is a wide-mouthed trumpet constructed from the [[binding]] of [[Subject One]]. This artifact possesses the ability to issue calls that reach other [[Dreadgods]] by mimicking the voice of the [[Slumbering Wraith]]. [[Reigan Shen]] maintains the item within his [[soulspace]] as a form of life insurance and a vital lifeline. Beyond its communicative properties, the horn can command [[Dreadgods]] and serves as a tool that enables them to travel through space.}}
